Careers

Join the team

The PxE team is developing new applications in holographic imaging never seen before. Come and be a part of an elite team in developing state-of-the-art technology.

Open positions

Senior SW Engineer

We are looking for a superhero Senior SW Engineer to join our team, with his/her main roles being:

  • End-to-end development of PxE’s software solution, managing the entire lifecycle from design and implementation to deployment and testing.
  • Crafting high-performance, multi-threaded software deployed on edge devices such as Jetson and Snapdragon.
  • Collaborating closely with our algorithms team to translate complex physical and mathematical concepts into optimally designed software for resource-constrained platforms.

What’s in it for you?

  • An opportunity to be a key part of developing a revolutionary product in an innovative start-up company.
  • Make an impact in solving real-world challenges.
  • A chance to grow, learn and develop with a great team.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years’ experience in SW development (C/C++).
  • ‘Figure-stuff-out’ and ‘get-stuff-done’ approach.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent collaboration capabilities and ability to work independently.
  • Experience with embedded software development – Major advantage.
  • Image processing experience (AI-based or other) – advantage.
  • Comfortable with version control systems (Git or equivalent), and familiarity with development-aiding tools (JIRA or similar)
Visual Perception Algorithm Expert

We are looking for a one-of-a-kind visual perception algorithm expert to join our team, with his/her main roles being:

  • Design and train new and non-standard inference models on unique and exclusive PxE holographic data.
  • Build modules for automatic generation of accurate 3D representation based on RGB+depth+IR data for imaged scenes, including their semantic content.
  • Design and implement real-time algorithms for visual perception targeting semantic scene understanding, action recognition, SLAM, tracking and prediction.
  • Design and execute applicative demonstrations, targeting real-world high-value machine-perception applications

 

What’s in it for you?

  • Develop and implement cutting-edge AI techniques for PxE’s unique holographic data.
  • An opportunity to be a key part in developing a revolutionary product in an innovative start-up company.
  • Make an impact solving real-world challenges.
  • A chance to grow, learn and develop with a great team.

 

Requirements:

  • 3+ years’ experience in AI-based computer vision research.
  • ‘Figure-stuff-out’ and ‘get-stuff-done’ approach.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent collaboration capabilities + ability to work independently.
  • Fluent in Python.
  • Industry experience – strong advantage.
  • Experience with embedded platforms and edge computing – advantage.
  • Classical (not AI-based) image processing algorithms and methods familiarity – advantage.
Senior Optical System Engineer

We are looking for an excellent and motivated Optical System Engineer to join our team, with his/her main roles being:

  • Full ownership of PxE’s camera electro-optics.
  • Innovate, design and test new concepts involving optics, holography and algorithms.
  • Overall image quality and system performance metrics.
  • Perform complex experiments integrating HW, SW and algorithms.
  • Develop PxE’s Active Alignment process.
  • Ownership of camera calibration processes.
  • Define and validate HW technical requirements.
  • Supply chain and vendor selection
  • Tackle end-to-end experiments and demonstrations.
  • Troubleshoot and debug a wide range of problems.

 

What’s in it for you?

  • An opportunity to be a key part in developing a revolutionary product in an innovative start-up company.
  • Make an impact solving real-world challenges.
  • A chance to grow, learn and develop with a great team.

 

Requirements:

  • Advanced degree in physics/EE/equivalent (M.Sc. or higher)
  • ‘Figure-stuff-out’ and ‘get-stuff-done’ approach. Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Excellent collaboration capabilities + ability to work independently.
  • Experience in:
    • Hands-on optics lab work
    • System engineering
    • Image analysis and processing – advantage
  • Fluent in Python
  • Industry experience – strong advantage
Physical Modeling and Algorithms Expert

We are looking for an excellent and motivated algorithm specialist to join our team, with his/her main roles being: 

  • Develop, mature and integrate new capabilities to the legacy algorithm pipeline, e.g.:
    • Physical modeling of a PxE camera
    • Hologram pre-processing
    • Hologram decoding
    • Color/depth/IR extraction
  • Accelerate the algorithm pipeline
  • Mature and stabilize the overall SW ecosystem
  • Develop tools for designing next-generation PxE DOE
  • Support experiments and demonstrations activity 

Requirements: 

  • Advanced degree in physics/EE/equivalent (M.Sc. or higher)
  • Motivated, independent with strong problem-solving skills
  • Experience in:
    • Physical modeling (optical modeling experience – advantage)
    • Algorithms development (image processing experience – advantage)
  • Fluent in Python
  • Industry experience – strong advantage
Business Development

We are looking for a driven and results-oriented Business Development professional to join our team, with his/her main roles being:

  • Identify, pursue and close deals with new B2B business opportunities
  • Support existing projects and relationships
  • Conduct market analysis and help guide the company roadmap

What’s in it for you?

  • An opportunity to be a key part in scaling a business from early on
  • A chance to work alongside an innovative team and sell a revolutionary product
  • Ability to broadly impact the company direction

Requirements:

  • 3+ years’ experience in business development, sales, or similar role, in a B2B environment, preferably in high-tech
  • Native or Full Professional English
  • Willingness to travel as needed
  • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed and achieve goals
  • Technical background or strong understanding of deep tech is an advantage
